Milwaukee beer-battered cheese curds.make_ahead: Pat dry and freeze the cheese up to 1 day ahead, and make the ranch up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; batter and fry just before serving

steps.text: Pat the cheese curds or halved cherry bocconcini dry and freeze 20 minutes.
Whisk the plain flour, the baking powder, a little garlic powder, the egg and the cold alcohol-free lager into a smooth batter.
Dust the cheese in flour, dip in batter and fry in the vegetable oil in batches at 185C for 1 to 2 minutes until golden.
For ranch, mix the sour cream, the buttermilk, the mayonnaise, chives, dill and garlic.

Psych-out pretzel bites with beer cheese.n: Psych-out pretzel bites with beer cheese
Psych-out pretzel bites with beer cheese.make_ahead: Roll and cut the bites up to 4 hours ahead, covered in the fridge, and make the alcohol-free beer cheese up to 2 days ahead; reheat it gently, then dip and bake the bites on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C.
Roll the pizza dough into ropes and cut into 3cm bites.
Simmer the water with the bicarb soda and dip the bites for 15 seconds.
Drain, place on lined trays, brush with egg, sprinkle with rock salt and bake 10 to 12 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and the alcohol-free lager, then the grated cheddar and the mustard until smooth.

Beers beer-braised bratwurst.make_ahead: Simmer the bratwurst in the alcohol-free lager up to 1 day ahead and keep them in the liquid in the fridge; grill and finish the onions on the night

steps.text: Put the bratwurst in a wide pan with the sliced onions, the alcohol-free lager and the butter.
Simmer gently for 15 minutes.
Lift out the sausages and grill on a hot barbecue for 6 to 8 minutes until charred.
Boil the onions in the alcohol-free lager until most of it evaporates and they're sticky.
Toast the long rolls and fill with a bratwurst, onions, warmed sauerkraut and hot mustard.

Denslow Cup brandy old fashioned.make_ahead: Steep and chill the smoky tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; muddle and build over ice to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove them and chill the tea in the freezer.
In each rocks glass, muddle an orange slice, a maraschino cherry, a teaspoon of sugar and a strip of orange zest until the sugar dissolves.
Fill with ice, add the cold tea, the apple juice and a drop of vanilla to each, then top with the lemon-lime soda.
Stir gently and garnish with another cherry and an orange slice.

Veal marsala.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; the veal and the grape juice sauce are cooked on the night

steps.text: Dust the veal in the seasoned flour and sear in butter and oil for 1 minute a side, then set aside.
Brown the mushrooms in the same pan, add the grape juice, balsamic vinegar and stock and reduce by half.
Whisk in the cold butter, return the veal and warm through for a minute.
Serve with crusty bread.
Whisk the yolks, sugar, grape juice and vanilla in a heatproof bowl over simmering water for 6 to 8 minutes until thick, pale and tripled in volume.
Halve the strawberries into four glasses.
Spoon the warm zabaglione over and serve straight away.

Charlie's Americano on Paulie's tab.make_ahead: Mix the aperitivo, grape juice and cooled tea in a jug up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; pour over ice and top with soda to serve

steps.text: Fill four tumblers with ice.
Pour the aperitivo, grape juice and tea into each glass and stir for 10 seconds.
Top with soda, stir once and tuck a half-moon of orange into each glass.
Peel and chop the potatoes.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper and brown it in the oil.
Add the mushrooms and cook until golden.
Pour in the stock and verjuice and simmer.
Boil the potatoes, mash with butter and milk.
Stir the cream into the chicken and serve over the mash.

Kir royale with cassis.make_ahead: Chill the flutes and the alcohol-free sparkling wine up to 1 day ahead; pour to order

steps.text: Chill the flutes and the sparkling wine for at least 2 hours.
Pour the blackcurrant syrup into each flute.
Tilt the glass and top slowly with the sparkling wine. Drop a raspberry into each and serve.

Seafood risotto.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; peel and clean the seafood and chop the onion, garlic and parsley up to 6 hours ahead, keep chilled; measure the verjuice and water on the night

steps.text: Peel the prawns, scrub and debeard the mussels, dice the onion, chop the garlic and chop the parsley.
Warm the fish stock in a saucepan. Soften the onion and garlic in the olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the carnaroli rice and toast for 2 minutes, then pour in the verjuice and water and stir until it is absorbed.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 16 minutes until the rice is nearly tender.
Stir in the prawns, squid rings and mussels, cover and cook for 4 minutes until the mussels open. Throw out any that stay shut.
Take off the heat and stir through the butter, the parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Serve straight away, no cheese.

Risotto three ways.make_ahead: Best served straight away; blitz the spinach and basil paste and soak the saffron up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; stir the verjuice and water together on the night

steps.text: Heat the chicken stock in a saucepan. Soak the saffron in 2 tbsp of hot water. Blitz the baby spinach and basil leaves with a splash of the stock to a smooth paste.
Soften the onion in 40g of the butter for 5 minutes, add the arborio rice and toast for 2 minutes, then add the verjuice and water and stir until absorbed.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 17 minutes until the rice is just tender.

Split the risotto into three pans over low heat. Stir the spinach and basil paste into the first, the parmesan and the last 30g butter into the second, and the passata with the saffron and its water into the third.
Spoon the green, white and red risotto side by side on each plate.

Oysters Rockefeller.make_ahead: Make the butter up to 1 day ahead; grill just before serving

steps.text: Blitz the spinach, parsley, spring onions, butter, breadcrumbs and ground fennel seeds.
Settle the oysters on a tray of rock salt and spoon over the butter.
Grill on high for 3 minutes until bubbling and serve hot with lemon.

Dry martini.make_ahead: Freeze the martini glasses up to 1 day ahead and chill the non-alcoholic gin; stir and strain to order

steps.text: Freeze four martini glasses for 30 minutes.
For each drink stir the non-alcoholic gin, verjuice and a few drops of olive brine over plenty of ice for 30 seconds and strain into a frozen glass.
Garnish with an olive on a pick.

Paul Bunyan cheese curds.make_ahead: Make the ranch up to 2 days ahead; whisk the batter and fry the curds to order

steps.text: Whisk the flour with some of the cold alcohol-free lager into a batter
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, dill and chives for ranch
Heat the oil to 185C
Dip the curds and fry for about a minute until puffed
Serve hot with the ranch

Walleye fish fry.make_ahead: Cut the chips up to 4 hours ahead in cold water, then dry well; shred and dress the cabbage up to 4 hours ahead, batter and fry the fish just before serving

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips and dry well
Shred the cabbage and toss with mayonnaise and vinegar
Fry the chips in the vegetable oil twice, once to cook through and once to crisp
Whisk the flour with cold alcohol-free lager into a batter, dip the flathead fillets and fry until golden
Serve with tartare

Kentucky stud farm steak.make_ahead: Cut the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and keep them in cold water in the fridge, dried well before roasting; sear the steaks and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Roast the potatoes in oil at 220C.
Sear the steaks hard and rest.
Deglaze the pan with the apple juice, vanilla and crushed black peppercorns.
Add the stock and cream and reduce.
Serve the steaks with potatoes and sauce.

Mint julep.make_ahead: Brew and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and make the sugar syrup up to 2 weeks ahead; build the cups to order

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove them and chill the tea until cold.
Gently press the mint leaves with the sugar syrup in metal cups.
Add the cold tea and a drop of vanilla to each and pack with crushed ice.
Stir until the cup frosts and top with a big mint sprig.

Hermosa Beach fish tacos.make_ahead: Shred the cabbage and mix the chipotle crema up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; whisk the batter and fry the fish fresh on the night

steps.text: Whisk the flour and cold alcohol-free lager into a batter.
Mix the sour cream with chipotle and lime juice to make crema.
Shred the cabbage and cut the flathead into strips.
Dip the fish in batter and fry in the vegetable oil at 180C for 3 minutes.
Serve in warm tortillas with cabbage, crema and lime wedges.
Simmer the sugar, water and sliced ginger for 5 minutes.
Cool.
Squeeze the oranges and the lime.
Fill tall glasses with ice and add ginger syrup and a squeeze of lime to each.
Top with the mixed orange juice and a splash of soda water, stir and add a blood orange wheel.

House of Blue Leaves yakitori.make_ahead: Make the tare up to 1 week ahead in the fridge; thread the chicken the day before and grill fresh

steps.text: Simmer the soy, rice vinegar, water and sugar until syrupy for the tare.
Dice the chicken and thread onto skewers, some with spring onion pieces.
Cook the rice.
Grill over high heat, brushing with tare.

Hanzo's yuzu sake sour.make_ahead: Brew and chill the green tea up to 2 days ahead and make the honey syrup up to 1 week ahead; shake each drink to order

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in 200ml of the boiling water for 3 minutes, remove them and chill the tea.
Mix the honey with the rest of the hot water for honey syrup.
Shake the green tea, grape juice, yuzu juice, syrup and egg white hard without ice, one drink at a time.
Add ice and shake again.
Strain into chilled coupes and finish with a twist of lemon peel.
Season the beef with salt and pepper and brown it in the neutral oil in batches.
Soften the chopped onion, carrots and celery, then stir in the tomato paste.
Add the stock, balsamic vinegar and thyme and return the beef.
Braise in a 150C oven.
Boil the potatoes towards the end of braising and mash with butter. Serve the stew on top.

Riggs' beach trailer michelada.make_ahead: Mix the lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire in a jug up to 1 day ahead and chill; rim the glasses, add ice and top with alcohol-free lager to order

steps.text: Mix the salt and chilli powder on a plate. Rub the glass rims with lime and dip.
Fill the glasses with ice and add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire.
Top with cold alcohol-free lager poured slowly, stir once and garnish with lime wedges.

Elephant supper duck with cherry sauce.n: Elephant supper duck with cherry sauce

steps.text: Score the duck skin, season with salt and pepper and render skin side down over medium heat.
Roast at 200C, then rest.
Simmer the cherries with the grape juice, balsamic vinegar and thyme until syrupy.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter until silky.
Slice the duck and serve with the cherry sauce.

Green fairy absinthe or green apple mint.n: Green fairy absinthe or green apple mint (alcohol-free)
Green fairy absinthe or green apple mint.make_ahead: Make the aniseed syrup up to 1 week ahead and keep it chilled; blitz the apples and mint up to 3 hours ahead and finish to order

steps.text: Simmer the star anise, caster sugar and water for 3 minutes, then cool for an aniseed syrup.
Blitz the apples with the mint and strain.
Put a splash of aniseed syrup in each small glass with ice, rest a sugar cube on a spoon over the glass and slowly drip apple juice over it until it dissolves.
Top with soda water.

Shower curtain ring onion rings.make_ahead: Soak the onion rings in the buttermilk up to 4 hours ahead, covered in the fridge; whisk the batter and fry at the last minute

steps.text: Slice the onions into thick rings and soak in the buttermilk
Whisk the flour, alcohol-free lager and salt into a batter
Heat the oil to 185C
Drain the rings, dip in the batter and fry in small batches until puffed and golden
Drain and serve hot

Home for Thanksgiving apple cider punch.n: Home for Thanksgiving apple cider punch
Home for Thanksgiving apple cider punch.make_ahead: Make up to 2 days ahead, strained and chilled; reheat gently to serve

steps.text: Put the apple juice, two cinnamon sticks, cloves, orange and sugar in a saucepan
Simmer gently for 15 minutes without boiling
Take off the heat and stir in the vanilla and lemon juice
Strain into a jug, pour into four mugs and serve with a fresh cinnamon stick

Fish and chip cones.make_ahead: Cut the chips up to 1 day ahead, kept in cold water in the fridge; batter and fry the fish fresh

steps.text: Whisk the flour, cornflour and alcohol-free lager to a batter.
Cut the potatoes into chips, rinse and dry them.
Fry the chips in the oil twice, first at a lower heat, then hot to crisp.
Dip the flathead strips in batter and fry in the oil at 180C until golden.
Serve in paper cones with tartare and lemon.

Blue lagoon.make_ahead: Mix the blue syrup and lemon juice up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; top with lemonade to serve

steps.text: Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Add the blue syrup and lemon juice to each.
Top with lemonade, stir gently and garnish with a lemon wheel.

Coffee liqueur ice cream cookie sandwich.n: Coffee liqueur ice cream cookie sandwiches
Coffee liqueur ice cream cookie sandwich.make_ahead: Make completely up to 1 week ahead, keep frozen

steps.text: Brown the butter, cool, then beat with the sugar and egg.
Mix in the flour, bicarb soda and choc chips.
Chill the dough overnight (included in cook time).
Bake 16 small balls at 180C until golden and cool.
Soften the ice cream and ripple through the espresso, stirred first with the caster sugar and vanilla. Refreeze for 1 hour.
Sandwich scoops between the cookies and roll the edges in the crushed coffee beans.
Freeze for 30 minutes before serving.

White Russian.make_ahead: Stir the cold brew, syrup and vanilla in a jug up to 2 days ahead, chilled; pour over ice and add the cream to serve

steps.text: Stir the cold brew, sugar syrup and vanilla together in a jug.
Divide the ice among four rocks glasses and pour 50ml of the coffee mix into each.
Top each with 30ml thickened cream and stir lazily.

Carmine Sabatini's veal marsala.make_ahead: Dust the veal in the seasoned flour and slice the mushrooms up to 4 hours ahead and keep chilled; sear and reduce the grape juice sauce just before serving

steps.text: Dust the veal in seasoned flour and sear in butter and oil for 1 minute a side, then set aside.
Brown the mushrooms, add the grape juice, balsamic vinegar and stock and reduce by half.
Whisk in the cold butter, return the veal and warm through.

Carmine's amaro spritz.make_ahead: Chill the aperitivo, sparkling wine and soda up to 1 day ahead; build over ice just before serving so it stays fizzy

steps.text: Fill four large wine glasses with ice.
Add the aperitivo to each, then the sparkling wine and soda, and stir once gently.
Slide a thin orange wheel into each glass and serve straight away.

Sam's rabbit stew.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the meat in the oil in batches.
Add the onions, carrots and thyme and soften.
Add the alcohol-free beer, stock and potatoes.
Simmer covered until tender.
Pour the apple juice and grape juice into a pot with the orange, ginger, cinnamon, cloves and honey.
Warm gently without boiling.
Stir in the lemon juice and ladle into mugs with an orange slice.
Brown the ribs all over in the oil.
Add the onions, thyme, stock, coffee and molasses, then water to come halfway.
Cover and braise at 160C for 4 hours until falling apart.
Boil and mash the potatoes with plenty of butter.
Serve the ribs on top of the mash.

Korg's spiced pineapple rum punch.make_ahead: Chill ahead, add ginger beer fresh

steps.text: In a big jug, stir the pineapple juice, passionfruit pulp, lime juice, vanilla, allspice and brown sugar until the sugar dissolves. Chill until ready.
Just before serving, add plenty of ice and the ginger beer and stir gently.
Drop in pineapple wedges and mint sprigs.

Big Whiskey bread pudding, whiskey sauce.n: Big Whiskey bread pudding, whiskey sauce
Big Whiskey bread pudding, whiskey sauce.make_ahead: Bake the pudding until set up to 1 day ahead and chill; reheat at 160C for 15 minutes and make the sauce fresh

steps.text: Tear the bread into a buttered dish with the raisins.
Whisk the eggs, milk, some of the sugar and cinnamon and pour over.
Soak for 20 minutes.
Bake at 170C until set and golden.
Melt the remaining butter with the remaining sugar and cream and simmer.
Stir in the vanilla and orange juice and pour over the warm pudding.

Whiskey trail coffee with cream.make_ahead: Best made fresh; whip the cream up to 2 hours ahead and keep it chilled

steps.text: Bring the water to the boil, stir in the coffee and simmer.
Take off the heat, splash in a little cold water to settle the grounds and rest.
Lightly whip the cream until just thick.
Put the sugar and a drop of vanilla in each mug and pour in the coffee carefully.
Spoon the cream over the back of a spoon to float it on top.

Veld celebration stew.make_ahead: Stew up to 2 days ahead, fry the chips fresh

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in the browning oil.
Cook the onions slowly.
Add the stock, coffee, molasses, malt vinegar, thyme, bay leaves and mustard and braise at 160C.
Fry the potatoes in the frying oil at 140C, then again at 180C until crisp.
Serve the stew with the frites.

Veld Belgian ale with orange and honey.n: Veld Belgian ale with orange and honey (alcohol-free)

ingredients.item: orange, peeled zest and 1 strip for garnish

steps.text: Simmer the orange zest with the honey, water and coriander seed, then cool and strain.
Put a spoon of syrup and a squeeze of lemon in each of 4 chilled glasses.
Pour the alcohol-free wheat beer slowly so it builds a head.
Twist orange peel over the top.
Dice the onion, carrots and celery.
Brown the lamb shanks in oil.
Add the onion, carrots, celery and garlic and cook.
Add crushed tomatoes, stock, balsamic vinegar, rosemary and bay leaves.
Cover and braise at 160C until the meat falls from the bone.
Peel and chop the potatoes. Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with butter and milk.
Reduce the sauce on the stove and spoon over the shanks.

Doc's blacksmith shop stew.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled, flavour improves

steps.text: Heat the oven to 150C. Season the beef and brown in the oil in batches in a heavy ovenproof pot.
Soften the sliced onions and chopped carrots in the same pot.
Return the beef, add the stock, molasses and malt vinegar and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise in the oven until the beef falls apart.
Serve with the crusty bread for mopping up.
Brown the chicken in the oil in batches and set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic in the same pan.
Add the mushrooms, stock, verjuice and tomatoes.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer.
Scatter with parsley and serve with the baguette.

Prom dinner chicken.make_ahead: Mash the potatoes up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled and reheat with a splash of cream; brown the chicken and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and mash with some of the butter.
Brown the chicken in butter, then finish in a 200C oven.
Fry the mushrooms in the pan, add the stock, verjuice and cream and reduce to a sauce.
Steam the beans and toss with butter.
Whisk the flour, egg, alcohol-free lager and salt into a smooth batter.
Heat the oil to 185C.
Dip the curds in batches and fry until puffed and golden.
Drain on paper and serve straight away with ranch dressing.
Cook the rice and keep warm.
Simmer the soy, rice vinegar, water and sugar until syrupy.
Sear the chicken skin side down, flip and cook through, then pour in the sauce and turn until glazed.
Slice the chicken over the rice and top with pickled ginger and spring onion.
Brown the beef in batches in a heavy pot.
Add the onions, carrots and paprika and stir for a few minutes.
Pour in the stock, coffee, molasses and enough water to cover.
Simmer gently until thick and tender.
Serve in big bowls with crusty bread.

Yule Ball roast.make_ahead: Gravy and carrots can be made 1 hour ahead

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Season the beef and roast for the first stage.
Drop the oven to 160C and roast the beef until 52C in the middle.
Rest the beef under foil.
Roast the potatoes in oil alongside the beef.
Whisk the eggs, flour and milk and bake Yorkshires in hot oiled tins at 220C.
Glaze the carrots with honey and roast.
Make gravy by simmering the beef stock and balsamic vinegar with the pan juices.
Brown the mince, add the tomatoes, stock and balsamic vinegar and simmer for 2 hours.
Make a bechamel with the butter, flour and milk.
Layer the meat sauce, lasagne sheets and bechamel in a dish, finishing with mozzarella.
Bake at 180C for 45 minutes.
Rest for 20 minutes before cutting.

Ron's Scotch Rob Roy.make_ahead: Brew and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; stir with ice to serve

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove them and cool. Chill the coupes in the freezer while it cools.
For each drink, fill a mixing glass with ice and add 60ml of the tea, 25ml of the grape juice, a drop of vanilla and a strip of orange zest.
Stir for 30 seconds until very cold.
Strain into the chilled coupe and drop in a maraschino cherry.
Twist a strip of orange peel over the top and discard it.

Drillers' whiskey ginger highball.make_ahead: Brew and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; build over ice to serve

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove them and chill the tea.
Fill four highball glasses with ice.
Add 40ml of the tea, a drop of vanilla and a squeeze of lime to each.
Top with cold ginger beer, stir once from the bottom and garnish with a lime wedge.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water.
Cool the syrup for 10 minutes.
Blend the coconut water, lime juice, syrup, bananas, vanilla and ice until smooth and pour into chilled glasses.

Bridget's chardonnay and peach sangria.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled without the soda

steps.text: Slice the peaches and orange into a big jug.
Add the grape juice, verjuice, peach nectar and honey and stir.
Chill for at least 1 hour, which is the resting time.
Fill 4 wine glasses with ice and fruit, pour in the sangria and top with a splash of soda water.

Walkabout Creek rum and ginger beer.n: Walkabout Creek rum and ginger beer (alcohol-free)
Walkabout Creek rum and ginger beer.make_ahead: Brew, sweeten and chill the dark tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; build the glasses to order

steps.text: Brew the tea bag in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove it, stir in the molasses and vanilla and chill.
Fill tall glasses with ice and add lime juice to each.
Add the ginger beer to each glass.
Slowly pour the dark tea over the back of a spoon so it floats on top.
Add a lime wedge and stir at the table.

Breathless Mahoney's gin gimlet.make_ahead: Chill the coupes in the freezer and juice the limes up to 1 day ahead; shake each round with ice to order

steps.text: Chill four coupes in the freezer.
Shake the non-alcoholic gin, fresh lime juice and lime cordial with plenty of ice until the shaker frosts over.
Strain into the coupes and float a thin lime wheel on each.

Peach Bellini.make_ahead: Blend and strain the peach puree up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; top with the chilled sparkling wine at the table

steps.text: Blend the peaches with the sugar and lemon juice until smooth and strain.
Put purée in each flute.
Top slowly with the sparkling wine and stir once.

Underhills' tab Bloody Mary.make_ahead: Mix the tomato juice, pickle brine, lemon juice and seasonings in a jug up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; rim the glasses and pour over ice to serve

steps.text: Mix the celery salt and pepper on a saucer, wet the rims of tall glasses with lemon and dip.
Fill the glasses with ice.
Stir the tomato juice, pickle brine, juice of one lemon, horseradish, Worcestershire and hot sauce in a jug.
Pour into the glasses and add a celery stick and a lemon wedge.

Officers' club Moscow mule.make_ahead: Muddle the ginger with the lime juice up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; build over ice and top with ginger beer to serve

steps.text: Chill the mugs in the freezer, then fill with ice.
Muddle a few slices of ginger with the lime juice and divide between the mugs.
Top with ginger beer and stir once from the bottom.
Garnish with a lime wheel and a slapped mint sprig.

Rod's kwan prickly pear margarita.make_ahead: Blend and strain the purée up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; shake and top with soda water to order

steps.text: Peel the prickly pears (or use the prickly pear purée), blend and strain out the seeds.
Mix the salt with a little chilli powder, wet the rims of the glasses with lime and dip.
For each drink, shake the purée, the lime juice, the agave syrup and a splash of orange juice hard with ice.
Strain over fresh ice.
Top with soda water.

Jazz club old fashioned.make_ahead: Brew and cool the tea up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; muddle and stir to order

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove them and cool the tea.
Muddle the sugar cubes with a splash of the tea, a strip of orange zest and the vanilla in a mixing glass.
Add 240ml of the tea and ice and stir.
Strain over a big cube in each glass.
Twist orange peel over the top.

Logan's limo bourbon and maple sour.n: Logan's limo bourbon and maple sour (alcohol-free)
Logan's limo bourbon and maple sour.make_ahead: Brew and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead in a covered jar in the fridge; juice the lemons up to 1 day ahead. Shake the drinks to order

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove them and chill the tea.
Dry shake 200ml of the tea, the vanilla, lemon juice, maple syrup and egg whites for a few seconds.
Add ice and shake hard.
Strain over a large ice cube in a heavy glass.
Add a tiny pinch of smoked salt on the foam and twist orange peel over the top.

San Gennaro red wine with white peaches.n: San Gennaro red wine with white peaches (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Brew the tea bag in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove it and cool.
Halve, stone and thinly slice the peaches into a large jug. Sprinkle with the sugar and leave for 10 minutes.
Pour over the grape juice, cooled tea and lemon juice and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Serve in tumblers with a spoonful of peach in each. Eat the peaches last.

Mum's blood orange mimosa.make_ahead: Juice up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Juice the oranges and strain.
Pour juice and a few drops of orange blossom water into each flute.
Slowly top with the sparkling wine and garnish with an orange wheel.

Long night spiked percolator coffee.make_ahead: Whip the cream up to 2 hours ahead, covered in the fridge; brew the coffee fresh

steps.text: Brew the coffee in a stovetop pot or plunger
Warm four heatproof glasses with hot water and tip it out
Put sugar and a drop of vanilla in each glass, add hot coffee and stir
Whip the cream until just pourable and float over the back of a spoon

Tequila with sangrita chaser.make_ahead: Brew and chill the green tea and mix the sangrita up to 1 day ahead; combine and pour to serve

steps.text: Mix the orange juice, juice of one lime, tomato juice and chilli powder for the sangrita.
Stir the green tea with the agave syrup, the salt and a squeeze of lime and pour into four glasses.
Serve each with a sangrita chaser alongside.
Shake the non-alcoholic gin, cherry juice, pineapple juice, lime juice, grenadine and a strip of orange zest hard with ice, in batches, until frothy.
Strain into tall glasses filled with ice and top with a splash of soda water.
Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry.

Midnight margaritas.make_ahead: Juice the limes up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; shake with the orange juice, agave and ice and top with soda to order

steps.text: Juice the limes and rim four glasses with flaky salt
For each drink, measure the juice of 1 lime, 30ml orange juice and 2 tsp agave syrup into a shaker.
Shake each drink hard with ice
Strain into the glasses and top with soda water. Best after midnight in the kitchen

Jake's Miami club rum punch.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Stir the juices, grenadine and vanilla in a jug and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Fill four tall glasses with crushed ice, pour the punch over and top with the ginger beer.
Finish each with an orange slice and a cherry on a pick.

Boddicker's gas station boilermaker.make_ahead: Brew and chill the smoky tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; pour into chilled shot glasses on the night

steps.text: Brew the tea bag in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove it and stir in the honey. Chill it with the lagers and four shot glasses in the freezer.
Pour the tea into the shot glasses with a small lemon twist.
Serve each shot alongside a cold alcohol-free lager poured into a chilled glass.

Consulate lychee and jasmine martini.make_ahead: Brew the jasmine tea and cool it up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; shake with the syrup, lime and ice to order

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the hot water and cool.
Drain the lychees, keeping the syrup.
Shake the tea, lychee syrup and lime juice with ice.
Strain into chilled coupes and drop a lychee into each.

Bumpy Jonas whisky sour.make_ahead: Brew and chill the smoky tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; juice the lemons and shake with ice to order

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove them and chill the tea.
Juice the lemons.
Shake 180ml of the tea, the vanilla, lemon juice and sugar syrup with ice, in batches.
Strain over fresh ice and top each with a cherry.

Bandit's bourbon peach sweet tea.make_ahead: Tea base up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water with the sliced peaches and sugar for 6 minutes, then remove the bags and stir in the vanilla.
Chill the tea with the peaches in it until very cold.
Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Top with tea and finish with a squeeze of lemon, a peach slice and a sprig of mint.

Reimers' night shift Irish coffee.make_ahead: Best brewed fresh; lightly whip the cream up to 4 hours ahead and keep it chilled

steps.text: Brew the coffee.
Stir the sugar and vanilla into the hot coffee.
Lightly whip the cream until thick but still pourable.
Pour the coffee into mugs and float the cream on top over the back of a spoon.

Tango's sharp-dressed Manhattan.make_ahead: Brew and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead; chill the coupes in the freezer, then stir with the juice and ice and strain to order

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove them and chill the tea. Chill the coupes in the freezer at the same time.
Stir 200ml of the tea, the grape juice, the vanilla and a strip of orange zest over ice in a jug until very cold.
Strain into the coupes and drop a cherry into each. Twist orange peel over the top.

Bonnie Doon lager and lime shandy.n: Bonnie Doon lager and lime shandy (alcohol-free)
Bonnie Doon lager and lime shandy.make_ahead: Pour to order so it stays fizzy; the limes can be juiced up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Chill four pot glasses in the freezer
Squeeze lime juice into each
Pour in cold alcohol-free lager, tilting the glass, then top with cold lemonade
Stir once gently and add a lime wedge

Stone house eggnog latte.make_ahead: Eggnog base up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Heat the milk with cream, sugar, cinnamon stick and vanilla until steaming.
Whisk the egg yolks in a bowl and pour in the hot milk while whisking.
Return to the pan and stir over low heat until slightly thick.
Brew strong coffee and divide between mugs.
Froth the eggnog milk, pour over and grate nutmeg on top.

Ashburn and Mullins whiskey sour.make_ahead: Brew and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; shake with the egg white and ice to order

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove them and chill the tea.
Shake 60ml of the tea, a drop of vanilla, the lemon juice, sugar syrup and egg white hard without ice in a jar or shaker. Repeat for each drink.
Add ice and shake again, then strain into short glasses over fresh ice.
Dot the foam with a few drops of syrup from the cherry jar and drop in a cherry.

Hawthorn smoked rosemary negroni.make_ahead: Mix the non-alcoholic gin, aperitivo and grape juice in a jug up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; stir over ice and smoke the rosemary to order

steps.text: Stir the non-alcoholic gin, aperitivo and grape juice with ice for 20 seconds, in batches.
Strain over a large ice cube in each tumbler.
Light the tip of a rosemary sprig until it smokes, blow it out and lay it across the glass with a twist of orange peel.

Shelter Mountain hot toddy.make_ahead: Steep the ginger tea up to 1 day ahead in the fridge and reheat to boiling; build each mug to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags and ginger in the boiling water for 3 minutes, then remove the tea bags.
Put honey and a splash of lemon juice in each of four mugs.
Pour in the ginger tea, stir and add a cinnamon stick.

Corto Maltese mango batida.make_ahead: Peel and chop the mangoes and juice the limes up to 1 day ahead, chilled; blend with ice and vanilla just before serving

steps.text: Peel the mangoes and juice the limes.
Blend the mango, coconut milk, lime juice, sugar, vanilla and ice until smooth.
Pour into four glasses.

Boat drink piña coladas.make_ahead: Toast the coconut up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Toast the coconut in a dry pan until golden, then cool on a plate.
Wet the rims of 4 glasses with a lime wedge and dip in the toasted coconut. Juice the limes and cut the pineapple into wedges.
Blend the coconut water, pineapple juice, coconut cream, lime juice and ice until thick and smooth.
Pour into the glasses and finish with a pineapple wedge and a cocktail umbrella.

\"I'm your huckleberry\" rye old fashion.make_ahead: Brew, sweeten and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; stir each drink to order

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove them, stir in the demerara sugar until dissolved and cool.
Stir 60ml of the sweet tea with a drop of vanilla and a strip of orange zest over ice, one drink at a time.
Strain over one large ice cube in a tumbler.
Squeeze a strip of orange peel over the glass near a lit match so the oil flares, then drop it in.

Val and Earl's bourbon iced tea.n: Val and Earl's bourbon iced tea (alcohol-free)
Val and Earl's bourbon iced tea.make_ahead: Tea up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water, remove, and stir in the honey and vanilla.
Cool and chill.
Slice the peach and one lemon. Fill four jars with ice and the slices.
Top with the tea, stir and serve with a squeeze of lemon.

Archie's midnight coffee old fashioned.make_ahead: Steep the tea and coffee and strain up to 2 days ahead, keeping it chilled; stir with ice to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bags and ground coffee in the boiling water for 5 minutes, strain through a paper filter and cool.
Stir 240ml of the coffee tea with the maple syrup, vanilla and a strip of orange zest over ice in a jug until very cold.
Strain into four tumblers over one large cube each.
Twist orange peel over each and float three coffee beans.

Logan's rye and maple old fashioned.n: Logan's rye and maple old fashioned (alcohol-free)
Logan's rye and maple old fashioned.make_ahead: Brew and chill the smoky tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; stir with the maple syrup, vanilla and zest over ice to order

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove them and chill the tea.
Stir 240ml of the tea with the maple syrup, vanilla and a strip of orange zest over ice in a jug until very cold.
Strain into four heavy tumblers over one large ice cube each.
Squeeze a strip of orange peel over each glass, rub the rim and drop it in.
